note: Secret Shop wave 2 kit items (next-wave/secret-shop/DESIGN-WAVE2.md). Shared by the app (src/fx/kit.ts, rigs/Kit.tsx) and the rest-frame compositor. Positions are paper-canvas fractions (1353 x 1530), like geometry.json; times in ms; rotations in degrees clockwise. Motion is calm by rule: loops are slow sines, moments are pose-to-pose keys on a smooth curve (no snaps), and nothing bounces.

plaid_backpack.blurb: Holiday lights twinkle on the strap, and a little gift pops up to say hi.
plaid_backpack._source: Alex's hand-drawn Christmas Plaid Backpack (items.id 488), cut from his paper: untouched. Bulbs, gift and snowflakes are wave 2 Codex GPT Image sprites (Alex's refs).

swirl_specs.blurb: Swirly spooky lenses. Watch for two tiny bats!

bubble_wand.blurb: Wave it and bubbles float up. Then a big bubble swoosh!

pocket_dragon.blurb: A tiny dragon rides on your shoulder and puffs sparkly smoke rings.

snow_globe.blurb: Your shark lives in a snow globe. Now and then: a gentle shake!

propeller_hat.blurb: A propeller cap that really spins. Tap your shark for a little lift!

wizard_hat.blurb: A floppy wizard hat that sparkles, then a shower of stars!

firework_crown.blurb: A gold crown whose points fire sparklers, one after another!

heart_halo.blurb: Hearts float around your head and do a happy heartbeat.

party_hat.blurb: A party hat with a wiggly pom-pom that puffs confetti!

holo_cape.blurb: A shimmery cape that changes color and flutters behind you.

top_hat.blurb: A magic top hat. Wait for it... a bunny pops out to say hi!

snow_beanie.blurb: A cozy beanie with its own little snowfall.

glow_boppers.blurb: Two glowy boppers that bob along and light up in turn.

cocoa_mug.blurb: A warm cup of cocoa. Watch the steam make a heart!

love_bug.blurb: A tiny love bug buzzes by your shoulder and blows heart bubbles.

storm_surge.blurb: Clouds roll over the cove, and far-off lightning lights up your shark.

pumpkin_cap.blurb: A jack-o-lantern cap that glows from inside. A tiny bat visits!

blossom_crown.blurb: A flower crown. Petals drift, and a butterfly stops by.

cloud_halo.blurb: Your own little rain cloud. It rains sparkles and makes a rainbow!

butterfly_wings.blurb: A butterfly wing pack that flaps slowly and leaves sparkle dust.

heart_balloon.blurb: A heart balloon that bobs on its string and does a slow twirl.

starlight_wand.blurb: A star wand. One wave leaves a trail of tiny stars.

chef_hat.blurb: A puffy chef hat. Poof! A cloud of yummy steam!

party_popper.blurb: Pop! A party popper that puffs confetti and streamers.

neon_visor.blurb: A cool sports visor with running lights and a scan beam.

snorkel_mask.blurb: Snorkel bubbles rise, and a little fish swims by to say hi.

coaster_buddy.blurb: A tiny coaster car rides its loop by your shoulder. Wheee!

splash_zone.blurb: Water jets dance behind you. Then: SPLASH!
